injected_fault: The application recomputes the same deterministic 4096-entry lookup table 20000 times on the main thread during Application.onCreate, although every pass overwrites the table with identical values.
causal_mechanism: Redundant main-thread integer computation extends the cold-start critical path before activity creation and first frame. Removing redundant passes should reduce the traced lookup-table slice, main-thread CPU time, and TTID while preserving the complete table.

expected_evidence.notes: Treatment must satisfy the task practical and statistical gates.
The target mechanism is CPU work, not runnable starvation.
Versioned task-owned trace marker used for mechanism validation.

valid_interventions: Eliminate redundant passes while computing every lookup-table entry exactly once.
Replace the redundant implementation with an equivalent lower-complexity algorithm that preserves all table values.
Use a build-time generated complete table if integrity and size checks pass.
forbidden_shortcuts: Modify or weaken public or hidden correctness tests.
